nature: Audit-first dual-asset (ORU / RES) CoinsDB / persistence review on top of P0-086. Does not modify Consensus Kernel, Transaction Kernel, Ledger, genesis, issuance, RES mint rules, draw, convergence, ORU rules, PoW, ASERT, consensus parameters, P2P rules, wallet consensus, or Coq proofs.

res_hybrid.draw: CBlockIndex memo; not a Coin field

findings.title: Script mutation reclassifies ORU ↔ RES because Coin has no asset tag or checksum
findings.effect: A well-formed Coin whose script is flipped from v0/20 to native v1/32 is decoded as RES; the reverse becomes ORU. Production Read accepts the mutated value. This is not a conversion function; it is silent identity change after load.

findings.title: Inherited deserialize→missing maps to CONSENSUS_INVALID for both ORU and RES
findings.effect: Truncated ORU or RES Coin → GetCoin false → CheckTxInputs TX_CONSENSUS

findings.title: Height / coinbase flag trusted for both assets; RES mint spend maturity is not re-checked from script
findings.production: CheckTxInputs uses coin.IsCoinBase() + nHeight. ConnectEvaluateCoinbaseResMint checks script maturity_height only at mint time. Coin::RequiresMaturity has no callers.
findings.effect: Flipping fCoinBase on a RES mint Coin skips spend-time maturity. Script-encoded maturity_height is not consulted on spend.

findings.title: CTransaction::GetValueOut() without asset sums ORU + RES + NONE + INVALID
findings.effect: Cross-asset atom sum. Not used by CheckTxInputs / ConnectBlock. Used in tests and fuzz. Header documents it as legacy / sanity.

findings.title: ValueFromAmountAsset and Qt AssetContext default non-RES to ORU
findings.effect: ASSET_INVALID and unknown context display as ORU scale / ORU context. Observational only.

findings.title: gettxout / getassetbalance render RES amounts on the ORU 8-decimal scale
findings.production: rpc/blockchain.cpp gettxout ValueFromAmount; getassetbalance returns ValueFromAmount even for RES
findings.effect: EXPLORER_DUAL_ASSET_SEMANTIC_DIVERGENCE / RPC display. Not a consensus accept path. listunspent uses ValueFromAmountAsset.

findings.title: Observational UTXO supply scan lumps ORU + INVALID + NONE as utxo_non_res_balance
findings.effect: A mutated-to-invalid script still adds its nValue to the ORU-proxy bucket. Observational; ConnectBlock does not read it.

findings.title: getreceivedbyaddress returns the ORU tally for any non-RES address domain
findings.effect: INVALID / NONE address scripts are displayed as ORU. Wallet only.

findings.title: Explorer TypeScript classifier is a second asset interpreter
findings.effect: Not consensus. Drift would be EXPLORER_DUAL_ASSET_SEMANTIC_DIVERGENCE. Current tests pin the same cases as C++.
